'''2016 EGP Chris Gogolen DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Gogolen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130058/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-endor-grand-prix.html Internet Archive]
